definitions.explanation: Doing something with complete focus and dedication, without distraction.

examples.japanese: ひたすら⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}けた→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧。
ひたすら⟦{謝|あやま}る→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧⟦しか→しか：09959_shika⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: All I could do was keep apologizing.

examples.japanese: ひたすら⟦{走|はし}り→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦{続|つづ}けた→〜続ける：02004_tsuzukeru⟧。

notes:
ひたすら emphasizes doing something with complete dedication and focus, often implying persistence over time.

USAGE:
Typically modifies verbs describing continuous actions. Conveys that one does nothing but that action.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ひたすら〜⟦{続|つづ}ける→〜続ける：02004_tsuzukeru⟧: to keep doing ~ single-mindedly
- ひたすら⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: to just wait and wait
- ひたすら⟦{謝|あやま}る→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧: to keep apologizing
- ひたすら⟦{努力|どりょく}する→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧: to work hard single-mindedly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧〜⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧: just, only (neutral)
- ⟦{一心|いっしん}に→一心：11236_isshin⟧: wholeheartedly
- ⟦{黙々|もくもく}→黙々：14712_mokumoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: silently and steadily
